newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end easier, volume thin.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end easier, volume thin.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly weaker on Monday, depressed by scattered profit taking in a continued technical correction after recent price rallies, traders said. Volume was thin.
Only the May contract was firmer. It ended up 0.1 yen per kg. Other prices ranged from flat to 0.6 yen weaker. Most-active benchmark July was unchanged at 156.0 yen.

Prices drifted sideways within tight ranges, failing to react to a slight fall in rubber stocks as of February 10 announced on Monday. "The market is looking for direction, and prices may consolidate at current levels," one trader said.
